text: Other important concepts that relate to such topic are skeletal maturity, bone age and chronological age. Skeletal maturity refers to the stage of development in which the bone is currently in [ 1 ]. Bone age is a closely related concept to skeletal maturity, and relates to the estimation of an age based on an individual’s skeletal maturity [ 2 ], whereas the chronological age is calculated based solely on an individual’s date of birth.
source_label: Bone age assessment with various machine learning techniques: A systematic literature review and meta-analysis
